svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 397 mm of 60 x 40 x 2 mm tube; square and deburr. The 60 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: faces are the sides; the 40 mm faces are the front and back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bush hole: 18 mm through both sides, centred, 40 mm below the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top end. Drill 6 mm pilot, open with a step drill, ream.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gearbox holes (right arm): four 6.5 mm through both sides on a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 44 mm square round the bush hole (22 mm each way). Check the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gusset bolt holes: 6.5 mm through the front and back faces,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred, 15 mm and 45 mm above the bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stands on the crossbar end; two gussets clamp it; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bearing plug fills its top 75 mm; the gearbox bolts to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the bush hole is square to the side (a 14 mm rod through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it stands at 90 degrees to the arm).
